subject: Error in loop - 1: In ctmm.fit(data, GUESS, trace = trace2, ...) : pREML failure: indefinite ML Hessian or divergent REML gradient.

messages.author: 0fb04d63730d7843
messages.subject: Error in loop - 1: In ctmm.fit(data, GUESS, trace = trace2, ...) : pREML failure: indefinite ML Hessian or divergent REML gradient.
parts:
Hi Chris,

I am running a loop to generate the home ranges for 200 moose. However, the loop works until it reaches a particular moose. I have recently run into this error:

1: In ctmm.fit(data, GUESS, trace = trace2, ...) :
  pREML failure: indefinite ML Hessian or divergent REML gradient.

I do not see any discrepancies in this particular moose telemetry data. When I subset the telemetry data based on this moose causing the error and rerun the loop for this particular moose on its own, I do not receive any errors. 

Do you have any thoughts on why this moose is causing this error in the larger dataset?

Thanks,
Carl 


my code looks as follows: 

thisMooseYrHr <- as.telemetry(thisMooseYr,timeformat="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timezone="UTC", drop = TRUE) 
  guessThisMooseYrHr <- ctmm.guess(thisMooseYrHr,interactive=FALSE) 
  finalThisMooseYrHr <- ctmm.select(thisMooseYrHr,guessThisMooseYrHr,trace=2) 
  finalThisMooseYrHrKernel <- akde(thisMooseYrHr,finalThisMooseYrHr) 
 . . .

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Error in loop - 1: In ctmm.fit(data, GUESS, trace = trace2, ...) : pREML failure: indefinite ML Hessian or divergent REML gradient.
parts:
Hi Carl,

That isn't an error, but just a warning (was there an additional error that also occurred there?). In the development branch of the package, that warning should no longer be issued if you are running ctmm.select (rather than ctmm.fit directly).

Best,
Chris
